# WP-08 worklog: role profiles and generated HR views (A7 FH; SL, PS, CM contributing)

- **Agent:** `emstagent:fh-agent@wp-08` (model `claude-opus-5-5`; prompt `docs/build/WP-08/prompts/wp08-role-profile.md@1`). SL, PS and CM are junior codes of the same agent (build plan §2): they review, they do not author separately.
- **Status of everything here:** agent-drafted. `status: draft`, `validationStatus: draft`, `reviewStatus: unreviewed`, evidence label S for every importance, time-share, critical, needed-at-entry, formation and target-level value (rater type `llm`). **Nothing here is a job analysis, SME agreement, Delphi retention or classification result.** Critical and needed-at-entry flags are LLM pre-fills that can never reach LLM-coder gate G2 (`validation/protocol_llm_coder_gate.md` §2); a qualified human must verify each one before it counts.
- **Counts:** generated by `build_wp08.py` (`manifest.csv`, `counts.json`), never typed.

## Rebuild
```
python3 docs/build/WP-08/build_wp08.py            # roles, variants, families, change atoms, manifest, counts
python3 pipelines/crosswalks/x5_state_classes.py   # links StateClassRecord.emstMapping.roleVariant (after any variant change)
python3 pipelines/crosswalks/x8_x11_private.py     # X11 incl. the WP-08 applicant-variant mirror rows
bash pipelines/views/build_views.sh                # FSP, State Class View, families, change view, mirrors, Forester PD, X2 frame, counts, tests
python3 scripts/validate_v2.py
```
